description: Check a video and show it. While the upload or the edit is still running, this waits for news before answering (up to 20 seconds; 50 in Claude), so call it again right away only if the user is waiting; the video card updates itself. state is waiting (give the user the upload link), uploading, editing, ready, draft (a rough cut, not the finished edit: say so and offer next_step) or failed (say problem and next_step). It also says when the length differs from the length asked. Download links are made only when asked: with_download: true (when the user wants the file).

import_id.description: The import_id edit_video gave while the upload is still on its way.

job_id.description: The job_id revise_video returned for a change by typing: also reports that change (its steps so far, then its reply, whether it changed anything, and anything it could not do).

output_id.description: One output to show (a hook, a Short or a shape); the main video when left out.

video_id.description: The video to check (from edit_video, create_video or list_videos).

wait.description: The video card's own refresh sends false to answer at once. Leave it out: waiting for news is what keeps a check from being wasted.

with_download.description: true: also make a 15-minute download link (only when the user wants the file).

name: check_video

outputSchema.description: Clypmint check_video result. Error results carry error; successful requests expose the identifiers and state available for the next step. Signed media stays in private metadata.

title: Check a video
